MODEL & CUSTOMIZATION PLANNING

OEM LED drinkware: from model selection to assembly review

For LED drinkware customization, review the vessel or accessory, lighting components and branding as one project.

Define the product and artwork

Start custom light up products with a specific cup, bucket, coaster, stirrer or ice-cube reference. For custom LED bar accessories, review the decoration area, artwork and packing on the chosen model; configurations are not assumed to be interchangeable.

Review production for the selected model

Custom LED product assembly requires a review of lighting components, activation, power, component fit and packing. Agree the applicable production steps and inspection scope through the selected model and sample review before approving the order.

选型与定制

LED 产品定制：从选型到装配审核

LED 产品定制应把杯具、酒具配件、灯光组件与品牌图案作为同一项目审核。

先确定产品与装饰

可从 LED 杯、冰桶、杯垫、搅拌棒和冰块参考型号开始。先选结构和装饰位置，再核对可用面积、图稿及包装；不同型号不默认采用相同配置。

按选定型号审核生产方案

装配方案需核对灯光组件、触发方式、供电、部件配合和包装。先通过样品或项目审核确定适用步骤、检验项目及责任范围，再安排订单。
